goal: Make the 320x240 iOS 6 lab match the kit, then port winners to agent/ios6-chat-ui. Main stays the terminal chat.
done_when: experiments/ios6/reference/chat.png exists and Messages RGB565 mismatch is under 8%, or the queue is empty.

skipped.reason: PlatformIO is not installed in this VM. Worktree of origin/agent/ios6-chat-ui is at /tmp/ios6-chat-ui @ 2ae8e70. When pio exists: LILYSHARK_RENDER_DIR=<dir> .pio/build/simulator/program --render-test and copy chat-01.ppm into experiments/ios6/reference/.

hard_rules: Do not edit src/sim_main.cpp on this branch.
Do not wait for the user. Do not ask the user to confirm.
Do not invent Apple copyrighted wallpapers or icons.
Bubbles stay content-sized and multi-line. Never collapse them to single-line strips.
Keep kIos6* / kChat* numbers in js/palette.js frozen to agent/ios6-chat-ui @ 2ae8e70.
Commit, push origin cursor/ios6-ui-lab-240f, and update PR 15 before ending a pass.
Re-subscribe timer + GitHub CI + GitHub PR if list_subscriptions is empty or expired.
Stop only when active is false, pass >= stop_after_pass, or done_when is met.
how_to_auto: Read this file first. Take queue[0]. Increment pass at the start of the pass.
messages-full-ios6-status-chrome-toggle: optional status-bar + carrier chrome on Messages that still keeps the kit title/OLDER/NEWER row. Do not steal the 3 px OLDER band (ChatOlderY=3).
If reference/chat.png appears, open Messages, onion-skin, and drive RGB565 mismatch down.
After the item: move it to completed or skipped, write notes, run test/ios6_lab, commit, push, update PR 15, re-subscribe, end the turn.
cursor-subscriptions subscribe_timer name ios6-lab-loop delaySeconds 180 recurring. Prompt: read experiments/ios6/LOOP.json and do the next queue item with no user input.
Also subscribe_github_ci on cursor/ios6-ui-lab-240f with notifyOnSuccess true, and subscribe_github_pr on PR 15.
